The data support this selection:
- Across all **300 samples**, measured fatigue strength ranges from **225 to 1,190 MPa**.
- The 32 samples with **CT=930** have a median strength of **1,029 MPa**, versus **496 MPa** for the remaining samples.
- The winning composition also achieves **1,124 MPa** with the same other settings but **Ct=469.8 and QmT=60**, providing nearby support for its high performance.
- Every proposed value below lies within its observed range.

The **1,190 MPa is a recorded measurement**, not a guaranteed future result. These data establish the best observed recipe, but cannot certify a global maximum over all untested combinations.

python - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd
pd.set_option('display.max_columns',30);pd.set_option('display.width',250)
df=pd.read_csv('b3_fatigue_data.csv')
print('Shape',df.shape,'Missing',df.isna().sum().sum(),'Duplicates',df.duplicated().sum())
print(df.agg(['min','max','nunique']).T)
print('\nTOP 20\n',df.nlargest(20,'target').to_string(index=False))
print('\nCorrelations\n',df.corr()['target'].sort_values())
print('\nProcess combinations\n',df.groupby(list(df.columns[:12])).target.agg(['count','mean','max']).sort_values('max',ascending=False).head(25).to_string())
PY

python - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd
pd.set_option('display.max_columns',30);pd.set_option('display.width',260)
d=pd.read_csv('b3_fatigue_data.csv'); carb=d[d.CT>30]
print('Carburized n=',len(carb),'vs other',len(d)-len(carb))
print(d.groupby(d.CT>30).target.agg(['count','min','median','mean','max']).to_string())
print(carb.to_string(index=False))
chem=list(d.columns[12:]);chem.remove('target')
print('Distinct alloys',d[chem].drop_duplicates().shape[0],'Carburized',carb[chem].drop_duplicates().shape[0])
best=d.loc[d.target.idxmax()];match=(d[chem]==best[chem]).all(axis=1)
print('Same alloy as strongest:');print(d[match].to_string(index=False))
PY
